Recreating “Sunset Moment”, the first favourite of the Weaving+ series, this pattern weaves the immersive blue hours from sunset to moonrise. The Weaving+ Moment Series captures such fleeting moments in aramid fiber weaving, after countless experiments and explorations.
Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, the case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It is light and strong, and a pleasure to hold every single time.

A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. It is seamlessly integrated and preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.
A sleek, barely-there profile preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
